# LM dictionary fixture

`mini_lm.csv` is a 34-row excerpt (same columns) of the Loughran-McDonald Master Dictionary
1993-2025 (Notre Dame SRAF, https://sraf.nd.edu/loughranmcdonald-master-dictionary/), used so
tests don't need the full 9 MB file. The dictionary is free for academic research; commercial
use requires a license from the authors. One row with a negative (removed) year is included to
exercise the removal rule.
